definitions.ask: Should the Alt+P chip glow once each time the review walk lands on a new TICK row?
definitions.why: One short settle draws the eye from the editor to the answer without looping

choices.label: The chip's tint fades from 32% to 13% over 900 ms once per row; reduced motion stays static
The chip is always static and stands out by shape and color alone

definitions.ask: Should the review-footer glossary strand describe the TICK Alt+P chip and its narrow-bar shedding order?
definitions.corrects: and as space runs out it drops groups from the end of the walk (marking the cut with `…`), then detail, hint, and meter.
